items.exampleEn: You need written permission from your parents.
items.exampleZh: 你需要家長的書面同意。

items.exampleEn: My little brother likes to wear weird hats.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜歡戴奇怪的帽子。

items.exampleEn: The outer walls of the house are painted blue.
Kids have endless questions about the world.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們對世界有問不完的問題。

items.exampleEn: The book is also available in digital format.
The movie had a horrible monster with three eyes.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影裡有一隻有三隻眼睛的可怕怪物。

items.exampleEn: Don't skate on the river; it isn't completely frozen.
items.exampleZh: 別在河上溜冰，河面還沒完全結冰。

items.exampleEn: Tie the box firmly so it won't open.
items.exampleZh: 把箱子緊緊綁好，才不會打開。

items.sentenceZh: 我們買了一些冷凍蔬菜。

items.audioEn: Please send me your answers in a written report by Friday, not by phone.
items.audioZh: 請在星期五前用書面報告把答案交給我，不要用電話。
items.questionZh: 說話者要大家怎麼交答案？
options: In person at the next meeting.

items.sentenceEn: That movie was so weird that I didn't understand it.
items.sentenceZh: 那部電影太奇怪了，我看不懂。

items.stemEn: We waited in the ____ line for three hours.
items.stemZh: 我們在沒完沒了的隊伍裡等了三個小時。

items.stemEn: The rules are ____ on a sign at the door.
items.stemZh: 規定寫在門口的告示上。

items.passageEn: Last winter, my class went camping in the mountains. The teacher gave each of us a written list of things to bring, but I forgot my gloves. On the first night, the weather was horrible: the wind was strong, and the lake near our tents was frozen. My hands were so cold that I couldn't hold my cup firmly. I heard weird noises outside all night, and the night felt endless. When the sun came up, I felt like a survivor. In the morning, I found that the noises came from the outer part of our tent: a branch was hitting it. Later, our teacher asked us to share our stories in any format we liked, so I made a short video.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我們班去山上露營。老師發給我們每人一份書面清單，列出要帶的東西，但我忘了帶手套。第一天晚上天氣糟透了：風很大，帳篷旁的湖也結冰了。我的手冷到連杯子都拿不穩。我整晚都聽到外面有奇怪的聲音，那一夜感覺沒完沒了。太陽出來時，我覺得自己像個倖存者。早上我發現，聲音是從帳篷外側傳來的：有一根樹枝一直打在上面。後來老師要我們用自己喜歡的任何形式分享故事，所以我做了一支短片。

questions.questionZh: 奇怪的聲音是從哪裡來的？
options: 一根樹枝一直打在帳篷外側

rubricZh: 用 weird 表示「奇怪的」（例如 a weird noise）
